description: This is the main source file for the front-end of a Tic Tac Toe game built with Flutter. It contains the main application widget, game logic, UI layout, and custom components for the game interface, including the game board, counters, and controls.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the app, setting theme and the home screen (TicTacToeScreen).

classes.name: TicTacToeScreen
classes.description: Main game screen managing game state, layout, counters, and controls.

classes.name: _CounterChip
classes.description: Widget displaying win counters for players X and O.

classes.name: _TurnPill
classes.description: Widget indicating the current player's turn.

classes.name: _Board
classes.description: Widget representing the 3x3 game grid with tiles.

classes.name: _BoardTile
classes.description: Individual tile widget for the game board with visual feedback for moves.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, runs the MyApp widget.

methods.name: _onCellTap
methods.description: Handles user taps on board cells, updating game state.

methods.name: _checkGameEnd
methods.description: Checks if the game has ended with a win or draw and updates counters.

methods.name: _showGameEndMessage
methods.description: Displays a message after game conclusion via SnackBar.

methods.name: _restartRound
methods.description: Resets the game board for a new round without affecting counters.
